chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb narrated from Abū ʿAlī al-Ashʿarī, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd al-Jabbār, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn al-Ḥajjāj, who said:

I asked Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام about a man who performed tamattuʿ with the ʿumrah leading to hajj, then entered Makkah, performed tawaf and saʿy, put on his clothes, exited ihram, and forgot to shorten his hair until he went out to ʿArafāt. He عليه السلام said: There is no problem with it. He builds upon the ʿumrah and its tawaf, and the tawaf of hajj follows after it.

key_terms.الْعُمْرَةِ: the lesser pilgrimage performed before hajj in tamattuʿ
key_terms.تَمَتَّعَ: performed hajj al-tamattuʿ by combining ʿumrah before hajj
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: the plain of ʿArafāt, a principal station of hajj
key_terms.وَسَعَى: performed saʿy between al-Ṣafā and al-Marwah
key_terms.يُقَصِّرَ: to shorten the hair as the concluding rite of ʿumrah al-tamattuʿ

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets taqsir after ʿumrah al-tamattuʿ until leaving for ʿArafāt?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one performing hajj al-tamattuʿ who forgot taqsir after completing the ʿumrah rites and only remembered after departing for ʿArafāt. Imam Abā Ibrāhīm عليه السلام rules that there is no problem, and that the person proceeds on the basis of his completed ʿumrah, with the tawaf of hajj to be performed afterward.
